source.note: common.md (Diagram detection): read once more with the comment line left out, `%%{`, whitespace, and `wrap}%%` form a closed directive; detection applies this reading before it asks whether the line is a bare `%%` line, skips the directive, and reaches the header; the lexer then reads `%%{` and `wrap}%%` as text, and the grammar rejects the input, as in mermaid.js.
